# Contributing to `mochi-forms`

## Code of Conduct

`mochi-forms` has adopted the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/) as its Code of Conduct, and we expect project participants to adhere to it.

Please read [the full text](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) so that you can understand what actions will and will not be tolerated.

# Contributing to `mochi-forms`

1. Fork this repository to your own GitHub account and then clone it to your local device.
1. This repo has a shortcut if you use `nvm` or `nvm for Windows`. If so:
   - Run the setup script: `npm run setup`
     > This will run the setup process, which will install a specific compatible version of node as well as any global node dependencies. In order to install node, you'll need to have installed node.
1. Run the following projects when contributing to:
   - `@mochi-forms/mochi-forms-docs-website`: `yarn start:docs`
   - `@mochi-forms/mochi-forms-react`: `yarn start:web`
   - `@mochi-forms/mochi-forms-react-native`: `yarn start:native`
1. Run `yarn test` to run Unit Tests.
